name: enable-code-coverage
description: Onboard a repository to Harness Code Coverage (HCC) in Harness CI: inspect test setups, wire the codeCoverage step immediately after unit tests, verify multi-module coverage reports, set up PR and baseline triggers, and configure exclusions via Harness MCP. Use when asked to enable code coverage, onboard a repository to code coverage, add coverage gating, or set up PR patch coverage checks in Harness CI. Trigger phrases: enable code coverage, onboard code coverage, add code coverage, patch coverage gate, baseline coverage.
